label: FDI Screening Compliance
description: Assess whether a transaction is notifiable under the EU FDI Screening Regulation (EU) 2019/452 and national screening mechanisms (Germany AWG/AWV, France IEF, Italy Golden Power, Nordic regimes). Covers notifiability triggers, the EU cooperation mechanism, standstill obligations, conditions/mitigation, and the financial-institution acquirer/target angle.

claudeKnowledge.description: EU FDI Screening Regulation (EU) 2019/452 (in force since 11 Oct 2020); Commission revision proposal COM(2024) 23 (forthcoming, not in force); national mechanisms — Germany AWG/AWV, France Code monétaire et financier (IEF / Art. R151-1 et seq.), Italy Golden Power (Decree-Law 21/2012), Nordic regimes (Sweden Screening of Foreign Direct Investments Act SFS 2023:560, Denmark Investment Screening Act, Finland Act 172/2012); EU Dual-Use Regulation (EU) 2021/821; Annex of (EU) 2019/452 listing illustrative EU programmes/projects of Union interest.

guidedInputs.label: Deal Facts & Known Concerns
guidedInputs.description: Describe the parties, the controlling chain, the target's activities, signing/long-stop dates, and any known sensitivities (state links, prior screening history, parallel merger control).
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Acquirer is a Gulf sovereign-wealth-fund subsidiary; target operates a Swedish data-centre serving a regional grid operator; signing in 6 weeks with a non-EU co-investor; parallel EU merger-control filing expected...

exampleInput: We are buy-side counsel on Project Aurora. The acquirer is a Luxembourg holding company ultimately controlled by a Gulf sovereign wealth fund (~70%) with a US private-equity co-investor (~30%). The target is a Swedish group that operates a colocation data-centre in Stockholm (a designated tier-3 facility serving a regional grid operator and a defence-adjacent SaaS tenant) and a smaller German subsidiary developing edge-AI inference chips. We are acquiring 100% of the equity. Signing is targeted in eight weeks, completion ~Q4. There is a parallel EU merger-control notification in preparation. Please assess: (1) is this notifiable under the Swedish, German and EU regimes; (2) what standstill obligations bite and what the realistic timeline looks like; (3) what conditions/mitigation a screening authority is likely to demand on the data-centre and the chip subsidiary; and (4) how the sovereign-wealth-fund control chain changes the analysis. Known concern: the data-centre's defence-adjacent tenant was not disclosed in the data room until last week, and we have no confirmed organigram above the Gulf fund.

exampleValues.known_concerns: Ultimate control sits with a Gulf sovereign wealth fund (~70%) above a Luxembourg holdco; defence-adjacent data-centre tenant disclosed late and not in the original organigram; parallel EU merger-control filing in preparation; no confirmed organigram above the Gulf fund.
